summary: Most faults are step pictures: big areas are first laid in as flat digital fills with no brush marks (coral clouds, fields, bushes, balloon, tree crown, violet field), and the next step jumps to finished detail (clouds step 4, bushes step 10, tree step 19). Machine patterns (tiled diamonds, wavy chevrons) and a stray line sit in the overpaint zones for many steps. The 'light' steps add colors their one named paint can't make (gold, violet, red, near-black), and several tips put light or marks on a different side or rows than the picture.
